content: {"summary":"fraud-scorer-02 was OOMKilled roughly every 10‑15 minutes after the 28 May node rotation; redis latency and tracemalloc were normal, but the pod was started with 32 gunicorn workers because WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset, exceeding its 3 GiB limit. Setting WEB_CONCURRENCY to 16 reduced workers and stopped the kills.","likely_cause":"Too many gunicorn workers (defaulting to CPU count) caused the pod to exceed its memory limit, leading to repeated OOMKills.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The pod was killed about 20 times, once every 10 to 15 minutes.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#2"],"quote":"the pod was killed about 20 times, once every 10 to 15 minutes."},{"text":"WEB_CONCURRENCY is not set, so the entrypoint starts one gunicorn worker per CPU it can see: 32.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY is not set ... starts one gunicorn worker per CPU it can see: 32."},{"text":"Setting WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 limited each pod to 16 workers and eliminated the OOM kills.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#2"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 set in the Deployment; both pods running 16 workers ... 15 minutes without a kill; resolved"},{"text":"redis‑features latency was normal and no feature‑fetch latency warnings were seen.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"redis-features --latency is normal and there are no feature-fetch latency warnings"},{"text":"tracemalloc showed ordinary allocations with nothing growing out of line.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"tracemalloc on one worker: allocations ordinary, nothing growing out of line"}],"next_checks":["Verify that WEB_CONCURRENCY remains set to 16 on all fraud‑scorer deployments","Monitor pod memory usage after the change to confirm stability","Check other services that derive worker count from CPU cores for similar issues"]}
